image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) resting on a textured, light-colored rocky surface. The beetle exhibits vibrant metallic green and bronze coloration with distinct pale cream markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes, and long, slender legs are visible splayed outwards. Long filiform antennae extend from the head.
